newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern says Conrail plan accepted.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern says Conrail plan accepted.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said Friday its proposal of a way to divide the Conrail Inc route system between it and CSX Corp had been accepted by all parties to the deal.

"On February 24, Norfolk Southern proposed to CSX and Conrail a plan to restructure the eastern rail system. That plan, which all sides have now accepted, will ensure that the combined Conrail/Norfolk Southern and the combined Conrail/CSX will compete at and between most of the major ports and markets east of the Mississippi," Norfolk Southern said in a statement.
The statement was released following announcement of a revised merger agreement between CSX and Conrail that allows CSX to negotiate a breakup of Conrail with Norfolk Southern.
Norfolk Southern spokesman Robert Fort said there could still be some fine points of the division to be negotiated, but the railroad's proposal had been accepted as the basis for the system split.
